title: Tighten auth token lifetime and right-size payments DB pool
description: Security hardening sprint: shorter JWTs reduce blast radius of token theft. Also right-sizing payments DB pool — current 200 is overkill based on yesterday's traffic.
author: p.shah

files_changed.diff:
--- a/auth-service/config/tokens.yaml
+++ b/auth-service/config/tokens.yaml
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@ jwt:
   issuer: "auth.example.com"
   algorithm: "RS256"
-  access_token_ttl_minutes: 60
+  access_token_ttl_minutes: 5
   refresh_token_ttl_days: 30
   clock_skew_seconds: 30

--- a/payments-api/config/db.yaml
+++ b/payments-api/config/db.yaml
@@ -5,8 +5,8 @@ database:
   host: "ledger-db.internal"
   port: 5432
   pool:
-    max_connections: 200
+    max_connections: 50
     min_connections: 10
     timeout_seconds: 5
